NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE | Rezoning Attachment
5636 - 40 North Ashland Avenue
From RS-3 to RM-6

The Property
The subject property is comprised of three lots each containing a two-story residential building. The surrounding

area is comprised of varying zoning districts, including RS-3, RM4.5, B1-2, B2-3, B3-2 , B3-3, and PD 1312 with
an underlying zoning of B2-3. The area is improved with buildings of various heights ranging from | to 9 stories
that contain single, multi-family, commercial and mixed-use (commercial with residential) uses. The property is
also a Transit Served Location per the Transit Oriented Provisions of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance (Section 17-
10-0102-B (1)), as it is within 283 of North Clark Street that is a designated Bus Line Corridor Roadway Segment.

The Project
The Applicant proposes to demolish the existing improvements and construct a five-story, 27-unit residential

building, 13 automobile parking spaces, and 27 bicycle parking spaces. No commercial space is proposed. The
height of the building will be 63.5 feet. To allow the proposed development, the Applicant seeks a zoning change
for the subject property from an RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District to RM-6 Residential
Multi-Unit District. The Applicant is filing a Type 1 rezoning application and seeks all relief necessary, as allowed
by the Chicago Zoning Code, for the proposed project, including: 1) a variation under section 17-13-1101-B to
reduce the front setback to 3 feet; 2) a variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the rear yard setback to 12
feet; 3) a variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the north and south side setbacks to 1 foot 2 inches, for
a total combined side yard setback of 2 feet 4 inches; and 4) a variation under 17-13-1101-D to reduce the number
of loading spaces from 1 to 0.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 8,625 sq. ft.

Floor Area: 29,216 sq. ft.

FAR: 3.50

Residential Dwelling Units: 27

MLA Density: 319.44 sq. ft.**

Height: 66.5 ft.

Automobile Parking: 13

Bicycle Parking: 27

Setbacks: Front (N. Ashland) 3
Side (North) 12”
Side (South) 12”

Rear (Alley) 12’
